scripts.prep:check: npm run design:build && npm run plan:check && npm run design:test && npm run design:check
scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter @ieum/core build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts build && node scripts/contracts/generate.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm --filter @ieum/core build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts build && node scripts/contracts/generate.mjs --check && node scripts/contracts/check-boundaries.mjs && node --test scripts/contracts/check-boundaries.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ieum/core build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @ieum/lab-cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @ieum/core typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @ieum/core build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts build && pnpm --filter @ieum/core test && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ieum/core build && pnpm --filter @ieum/contracts build && pnpm --filter @ieum/lab-cli build
